scenario: Hyphens are not permitted in identifiers per LLEX.10.5 — multi-word identifiers use underscores. A schema name containing a hyphen is a parse error. Pin: `schema My-Schema` rejects at parse since TYPE_NAME regex is `/[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9_]*/` and hyphens are not included.
